Moment when a solo artist comes back after intense applause.
impacto_motivo: The encore is an emotional moment that marks the final connection between the group and fans at the concert.

significado: A song's victory on a weekly Korean music show, one of the main indicators of a comeback's popularity.
exemplo_correto: The group celebrated a lot when they got their first music show win of their career.
exemplos_incorretos: The host announced the wrong music show win during the live recording.
The local radio created a music show win to pick the month's most requested song.
The daytime TV show ran a music show win among the audience members.
significados_incorretos: Poll used by local radio stations to pick the month's most played song.
Broadcast error that happens during live show recordings.
Audience game used on generic TV shows.
impacto_motivo: Music show win is celebrated as a concrete achievement of popularity and comeback success.

significado: A series of concerts performed by the group in different countries, allowing direct contact with international fans.
exemplo_correto: I got a ticket for the world tour and I'll finally see the group live.
exemplos_incorretos: The symphony orchestra announced a farewell world tour for the conductor.
The classic rock band confirmed a world tour after twenty years of inactivity.
The international circus organized a world tour across several continents.
significados_incorretos: Series of farewell performances by a symphony orchestra.
Comeback tour of a rock band after a long hiatus.
Series of performances by an international circus in different countries.
impacto_motivo: The world tour is eagerly awaited by fans because it allows in-person contact with the group.

significado: An official event where idols interact directly with a large group of fans through games, conversations and performances.
exemplo_correto: The fan meeting had super fun games and the group sang acoustic songs.
exemplos_incorretos: The school organized a fan meeting between students and graduated alumni.
The chess club held a fan meeting among players from the region.
The company held a fan meeting among employees from different branches.
significados_incorretos: Meetup promoted by schools between current students and alumni.
Gathering organized by hobby clubs among members of the same region.
Internal get-together organized by companies between different teams.
impacto_motivo: The fan meeting is celebrated as a unique and special opportunity for close interaction with idols.

significado: An official photo released before the comeback, revealing the visual aesthetic of the group's new era.
exemplo_correto: This comeback's concept photos already have fans anxious for the album.
exemplos_incorretos: The fashion photographer organized a concept photo for the month's magazine.
The advertising agency produced a concept photo for the summer campaign.
The studio did a themed concept photo for the brand's catalog.
significados_incorretos: Themed photo shoot produced by fashion magazines.
Image produced by advertising agencies for seasonal campaigns.
Themed photograph used in clothing brand catalogs.
impacto_motivo: Concept photo builds positive anticipation by gradually revealing the aesthetic of the new comeback.

significado: Short content released before a comeback to build anticipation, which can be a photo, video or song snippet.
exemplo_correto: The MV teaser already showed a little bit of the new choreography.
exemplos_incorretos: The movie theater released the film's teaser almost a year before its premiere.
The production company released the new series' teaser on social media.
The video game company released a surprise teaser during the company event.
significados_incorretos: Short preview released before movies premiere in theaters.
Promotional content released before TV series launch.
Short video used by game companies to announce upcoming releases.
impacto_motivo: The teaser is welcomed with excitement by fans for previewing details of the comeback.

significado: An official album presentation event, usually with live performance and an interview right after the release.
exemplo_correto: The debut showcase had the new group's first live performance.
exemplos_incorretos: The automaker organized a showcase to reveal the new electric car.
The fashion brand held a showcase during the city's fashion week.
The tech company held a showcase to launch the new product.
significados_incorretos: Presentation event used by automakers to reveal new vehicles.
Presentation show held during fashion weeks.
Corporate event used by tech companies to launch products.
impacto_motivo: The showcase marks a debut moment celebrated by fans, full of positive anticipation.

significado: Official licensed products of a group, such as T-shirts, keychains, posters and other collectible items.
exemplo_correto: I bought some new goods from the group at the official store during the tour.
exemplos_incorretos: The supermarket put the perishable goods on sale this week.
The factory reviewed the stored goods before the monthly inventory.
The carrier delivered the imported goods straight at the port.
significados_incorretos: Generic term used to refer to perishable merchandise.
Merchandise stored in stock awaiting inventory at a factory.
Imported products transported and delivered by logistics companies.
impacto_motivo: Goods are valued by fans as a way to support the group and express their affection for the fandom.
